title: Spellforge Insectarium
description: A woman with three faces and magenta curly hair stands at a chained booth labeled 'Spellforge Insectarium Garden of Chains' selling lavender and insects under an 'Open for Chaos' banner. A fiery red dragon flies over a fantasy landscape of purple flower fields, a winding river, wooden walkways, and a distant castle with floating masked faces on the mountains.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene with a three-faced woman with long curly magenta hair wearing a black gothic dress standing at a wooden chained booth labeled Spellforge Insectarium Garden of Chains, selling potted lavender and insects, an orange banner above reads Open for Chaos, a large fiery red dragon breathing flames flies across the sky, in the background are purple lavender fields, a winding blue river with wooden walkways, a distant castle on mountains, and several large masked faces carved into the hills, detailed line art with vibrant watercolor accents, whimsical and chaotic atmosphere
